verdict.rationale: Phone control is a fair question for a computer-use agent, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Sai running on cloud Windows computers and on Mac mini, macOS and Windows devices, with nothing about tapping, swiping or typing on a real phone. Getting notifications and approving steps via iMessage, SMS or Telegram is a chat-notification feature, not device control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, the agent operates a real phone (tap, swipe, type) to finish a task I describe in plain language
